opportunity.role_description:
Join PEP as a Part-Time Sales Assistant - a culture of growth and development, with the opportunity to work up to 27 hours a week. At PEP, we're known as Dynamos - we work hard, have fun, and take pride in everything we do. As a Dynamo, you'll be dynamic, helpful, and committed to ensuring our customers look and feel great.


Purpose of Position:

As a friendly team player, your role involves promoting sales, minimising stock losses, managing inventory, assisting customers, operating the cash register, and upholding a low-cost culture to achieve business objectives. At PEP, we nurture a culture that encourages our team members to grow from within, offering chances for professional development and advancement within the company. This helps our team thrive and realise their full potential.


If this sounds like you and you want to be part of the PEP family, apply through the JOBJACK platform, where we find our new team members. It's really important that you're honest and trustworthy, especially when it comes to handling money.


*The position requires honesty in dealing with cash or finance.

opportunity.role_description:
Purpose of the Position:

Operating palletising machinery, handling packaging materials, and ensuring finished products are prepared and stacked correctly for storage or dispatch. This includes feeding packaging components such as shrink wrap, labels, and caps, ensuring products are correctly packaged, and maintaining the palletising area according to quality, safety, and production standards.

Skills and Behavioural Competencies:

  • Experience: Ability to operate palletising equipment
  • Knowledge: Basic knowledge of packaging processes
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to stand, lift items and walk during 10 to 12-hour shifts
  • Physical Ability: Ability to lift, move, and stack products safely and to complete job duties, which may include standing for long periods and lifting objects with an established maximum weight of 12kg at 400 units per hour
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to spot defects and maintain accuracy in documentation
  • Problem-Solving: Identify, analyse, and resolve minor production issues, such as machine malfunctions or raw material defects, efficiently
  • Clear Communication: Communicate clearly with colleagues and supervisors regarding issues, feedback, or task completion
  • Adaptability & Flexibility: Adapt to changing priorities, new manufacturing processes, or technology updates within the workplace
  • Time Management & Reliability: Manage time efficiently to meet tight production deadlines and attendance expectations
  • Safety Consciousness: Proactively follow safety protocols to prevent accidents and hazards, ensuring compliance with OSHA or similar regulations
  • Methodical Working: Complete tasks in a systematic, orderly manner, ensuring each step of the production process is followed correctly
  • Self-Management/Initiative: Works effectively with minimal supervision, taking initiative on cleaning and organizing the workstation
  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Collaborate with teammates and other departments to achieve shared production targets
  • Interpersonal Skills: Maintain positive and professional relationships with team members, promoting a productive work atmosphere
  • Machine Operation & Maintenance: Demonstrate a willingness to learn the operation and basic maintenance of tools and machinery
  • "Hands-on" Mindset: Show a practical, mechanically inclined approach to handling, assembling, or cleaning materials
  • Overtime: Must be willing to work weekends, holidays and overtime as may be required from time to time due to operational requirements

We are looking for a Food Service Team Member to join our team! As a Team Member your main job is to make sure our kitchen runs smoothly. You'll be responsible for getting tasks done efficiently so we can serve our customers delicious food.
